# Rok Retar, mobile engineer

> Rok Retar is a mobile engineer in Slovenia who builds apps in Kotlin, for Android and iOS. He designed and led the move of a company's production iOS app onto shared Kotlin. He also builds Parrot, an ebook and audiobook reader for Android. This site is written in Kotlin with Kobweb.

## About
Rok works across Android and Kotlin Multiplatform: shared domain and data layers in Kotlin, with native UI where the platform does it better. His daily stack is Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Compose Multiplatform, Ktor, Koin, Decompose, SQLDelight with SQLCipher, and SKIE. Besides the iOS migration, he has shipped an AI platform with real-time chat, a gaming app with NFC and cashless payments, and Parrot.

He is open to senior mobile engineering roles, Kotlin Multiplatform migrations and Android architecture work, remote across the EU.
